RECENT CONVERSATION CANON UPDATE — 2026-09-22

1. CONTROL ARCHITECTURE
USER → LCAS → CONDUCTOR → CAPABILITIES/PROVIDERS → EXECUTION SERVICES.

LCAS presents control/activity/status and persistent user-facing project state.
CONDUCTOR owns intent interpretation, planning, orchestration, sequencing,
dependency resolution, decisions, QA coordination, consolidation and release.

2. BIFROST
Canonical phrase: CONNECT & KEEP.
BIFROST is “My Gateway to EDEN.”
Owns gateway/base-app concerns including identity, persistence,
interoperability, applications/packages and provider connections.
BIFROST remains useful without AI and must not become a compulsory dependency
for independently usable specialist apps.

3. HEIMDALL
Canonical phrase: ORGANIZE & UNDERSTAND.
Owns Workspaces and shared information organization: files, assets, indexing,
metadata, relationships, collections, search, representations, provenance,
versions, storage abstraction, import/validation and information access.

4. SPECIALIST APPS
Canonical phrase: SPECIALIZE & DO.
Examples include SKALD, HERMES, MONETA, CURATOR, GardenOS, PROMETHEUS and
other domain applications. Preserve independent packages and contracts.

5. REUSE
IMPLEMENT / INTEGRATE EXISTING CAPABILITY BEFORE RECREATING IT.
Progressive integration path:
LINK → TAB/WEBAPP → EMBED → NATIVE.
Reuse EDEN apps, native OS capabilities, installed applications, WebApps/PWAs,
external providers, open-source components and shared helpers before rebuilding.

6. RELEASE EVIDENCE
Never infer PASS from existence.
Use PASS / FAIL / UNKNOWN / NOT_APPLICABLE.
UNKNOWN is never PASS.
Private experimental development precedes Family & Friends Alpha.
Only verified working components are promoted.

7. LOCALIZATION
Private / Custom / Experimental: English + Slovak.
Public/final/distributable: multilingual by design through LINGUA.
English is canonical/reference and fallback; Slovak is baseline.

8. INSTALLATION
INSTALL / RECOMMENDED = balanced, device-aware primary action.
LEAN = minimum core.
FULL = all appropriate supported capabilities.
CUSTOM = explicit component/provider choices.
Install must not mean install everything.

9. PROJECT GOVERNANCE
One authoritative PROJECT_MANIFEST.json.
One append-only [PROJECT]_CHAT_HISTORY.txt.
Stable IDs and traceability:
requirement → task/job → artifact → test/evidence → verification → release.
Lifecycle:
NOT_STARTED → READY → ACTIVE → PRODUCED → REVIEW → CORRECTION → VERIFIED → COMPLETE.
Completion, verification and health remain distinct.

10. CONSTITUTION
Hard rules are explicitly separated from suggestions/preferences.
Confirmed rules are versioned, never silently rewritten.
Rule changes trigger dependency impact analysis and reverification.
Release requires a Release Constitution Gate.

11. LEGACY MIGRATIONS
LUCAS/UIbasic → LCAS where referring to the canonical control/status UI layer.
WEAVER/FRAME → SCAFFOLD where referring to the shared application/UI
scaffolding role established in recent AppDev work.
Do not rename independent established frameworks merely because a migration
exists elsewhere; retain provenance and aliases.
